title: Neuron Signal Transmission
hint: Tap the soma or Fire signal to send an action potential
guideIdle: 1) Fire a signal · 2) Toggle myelin on/off · 3) Compare how fast the gold pulse travels
guideFired: Watch the action potential race along the axon toward the terminal
guideMyelin: Myelin lets the signal jump between nodes of Ranvier — much faster!
guideNoMyelin: Without myelin the signal crawls continuously — much slower.
tapNode: Tap a blue node to restart from here
learnMore: Myelin is fatty insulation. Gaps (nodes of Ranvier) let the impulse “jump.”
raceLocked: Try myelin ON and OFF once each to unlock
quizQuestion: Why was the myelinated axon faster?
quizOptionJump: It jumps between nodes of Ranvier (saltatory)
quizOptionThicker: The axon just got physically thicker
tipOverlay: Tip: Watch the gold pulse hop node-to-node — then toggle myelin OFF to see it crawl instead!
triadNowMyelin: The impulse leaps from node to node, skipping the insulated stretches (saltatory conduction).
triadNowBare: Without insulation, every patch of membrane must fire in turn — a slow, continuous crawl.
triadNowRaceHeat1: Race heat 1/2 — myelinated axon sprinting toward the terminal.
triadNowRaceHeat2: Race heat 2/2 — bare axon crawling the same distance.
triadNowRaceDone: Race finished — compare the two lap times in the chart below.
triadNowDemyelination: Demyelination challenge — myelin locked OFF, signal crawling slowly.
triadWhyMyelin: Myelin insulates the axon, so voltage-gated channels only need to open at the gaps (nodes of Ranvier).
triadWhyBare: No insulation means the signal must regenerate continuously along the whole membrane — much slower.
triadWhyDemyelination: Diseases like multiple sclerosis strip myelin, forcing slow (or failed) continuous conduction.
triadNextToggle: Toggle myelin to compare the other mode.
triadNextRaceLocked: Try both myelin states, then race them!
triadNextRace: Start the Myelin race to time both modes.
triadNextIons: Turn on Show ions to see Na⁺ rush in at each hop.
triadNextDemyelination: Try the Demyelination challenge to see disease effects.
hintAxonGeometry: Longer axons and fewer nodes change how fast the pulse hops.
hintSignal: Fire needs stimulus above threshold — scrub both sliders.
hintPlayback: Step once advances one frame; auto-repeat refires after each lap.
